limitations: BoardGuard is a visual inspection aid. It does not measure electrical continuity, resistance or function; a photograph cannot prove or exclude a short or open circuit.
Candidates are suspected visual anomalies localised by classical OpenCV image analysis with documented, hand-calibrated thresholds. Evidence scores are heuristic and are not calibrated probabilities.
Thresholds were calibrated on a small set of public PCB photographs and controlled degradations of them, not on a validated corpus of repair cases.
Software zoom is not optical magnification; lighting guidance must be carried out physically by the technician.
A visible change between before and after captures documents a visual difference only. It does not establish that a repair succeeded.
